ELSPETH × BELL, married. MAGNOLIA × DAISEY, married. ALEXIS × LYRIC, dating. CLAUDIA × HELA, dating. FELICITY × ORIANNA, married. EIRWEN × REMIELLE, dating. Twelve girls, six couples — exactly the pattern the other two houses hold, which the Archive predicted and refused to guess for four days.

AND THE HOUSE HAS ITS BODY. Banshee Haven is THE TITTY HOUSE, shaped from Bell's chest, because Elspeth could not keep her hands or her cock off it during construction. Ghost Haven took Bella's shape because of Sera. Specter Haven took Arianna's. The land has now done this three times for three different reasons, and every reason has been somebody's wife.

BELL is house lead — Maribel Grace Holloway, goth girl, part-time chaos agent, THE ORACLE OF SEANCES. Arc 13 is called Seance at Sundown and it is named for her. ELSPETH CLARA HOLLOWAY is a cottagecore paladin baker and hearthkeeper, the second paladin in this canon after Gwen, and Sir Trashmuffin's ally on heists inside her own house — which is what they got for putting a girl in the Enforcer pool at 01-399 for looking frightening while being incapable of harm.
